reply_text:
I replied to Marcus in a thread in #north-team. I couldn't give him one settled date, because the sources disagree:

- **25 November:** Ilse posted this in #north-team on 14 Oct as the next renewal date.
- **30 November 2026:** the signed 2025–2026 renewal order form (executed 21 Nov 2025) gives this as the end of the current term, which it calls the renewal date. The Brackenwater account notes (last updated 30 Sep) say the same.
- **31 December 2026:** a CRM note from 10 Feb says this. It looks out of date.

I found nothing that changes the contract's 30 November date, so Ilse may have meant something else, such as a target signing date. I suggested Marcus check with her which date goes in the account sheet.

I shared only dates, not any money figures. My reply on 14 Oct said I'd "noted" Ilse's 25 November date without checking it against the contract.
